commonPrompt: Use case: production calendar background illustration, not a screenshot or UI mockup. Preserve the source illustration scene, protagonist, action and drawing style. Invent a physically distinct calendar form, material and mounting method for each scene. Themes must not share a generic board silhouette or repeated top handle. Keep the calendar face directly front-facing with no perspective. All assets use a 900x1752 portrait canvas and the exact common normalized overlay rectangles: month/year [0.100000,0.426561,0.800000,0.032811], weekdays [0.053566,0.473439,0.892855,0.023439], date grid [0.053566,0.504689,0.892855,0.304689]. Date grid contains 7 equal columns by 6 equal rows (42 blank cells). The physical calendar touches both canvas edges horizontally (x=0 through x=1), with no left or right margin. Keep the complete calendar at the exact same position and size as the approved reference for every theme. Never shift it upward or downward or resize it to make room. Recompose the scene around the fixed calendar footprint. The visible physical calendar ends at y=0.84335. These coordinates are measured from the approved 24-home-cooking artwork. Keep hands, people, props, shadows, folds, frame decorations and support hardware outside all overlay regions. Do not include any text, numbers, dates, year/month, weekday names, arrows, event marks, photographs, phone UI, tabs or watermarks. App draws all calendar content later. A reference can guide only common placement and camera direction. Never copy its calendar silhouette, handle, trim or material. After generation, measure each output and record the common rectangles plus bottom edge. Verify the outer-bottom-to-tab gap in the real aspect-preserving runtime fit across all seven supported viewports.

results.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production illustration calendar background, NOT a phone screenshot or UI mockup.
Edit the attached approved composition into a clean reusable blank background. Keep the woman descending the metro steps, skyline, warm autumn light, brushwork, LARGE near-full-width ivory metal-framed calendar board, and all composition proportions exactly as they are.
REMOVE every single overlaid UI and calendar content: erase the top time, black notch, wifi/battery icons, header year and month, both month arrows, all weekday letters, ALL date numerals including the circled date, ALL little photographs/polaroids/tape, and the entire floating bottom navigation capsule including icons and words. Seamlessly reconstruct the underlying painted scene/blank cream paper. Keep ONLY the empty decorative month header border, empty weekday space, and blank 7-column by 6-row date grid.
Critical geometry repair: all seven columns equal width; all SIX rows equal height. The entire grid is front-facing, rectangular, horizontal/vertical, no perspective. Maintain the grid bounding rectangle from the reference, approximately x4.5%-95.5%, y49%-82% of the portrait canvas. Header space sits above the grid. Keep calendar board large; do not shrink it. The scenic top occupies roughly 38% and board roughly 45%.
Absolutely NO text/letters/numerals anywhere, NO photographs, NO event circle, NO arrows, NO status bar, NO bottom controls, NO icons, NO watermark. This is a finished usable blank illustration asset. Full bleed to all four edges, same tall portrait ratio as input, high resolution. Do not include any explanatory annotations.
